title: Tokamak shot, cut away
label: A tokamak on a round two-tier plinth, cut open at the front: glowing plasma in the dark vessel round the gridded inboard wall, D-shaped field coils, flat C-shaped field rings, ports, pipes, bellows and a shot timeline in the base.
caption: No wall touches the plasma: the solenoid drives its current while the coils and rings hold it off the dark first wall. Move across the figure to run the shot along the timeline, from breakdown up to the 3.5 MA flat-top and back down onto the limiter.
